text.p: The Cinder Barrow is a short starter for Ironsworn (with Delve): one to four characters, one or two sessions, with or without a GM. It is Kraken's own, an unofficial adaptation (see the Ironsworn Reference's front page).

This work is based on Ironsworn, Ironsworn: Delve and Ironsworn: Starforged, created by Shawn Tomkin, and licensed for our use under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

This is an unofficial adaptation made for Kraken VTT, compatible with Ironsworn and Ironsworn: Starforged. It is not an official Tomkin Press product, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shawn Tomkin or Tomkin Press. It uses no Tomkin Press art, icons or trade dress. The full rulebooks (free to download from the publisher) explain the games in far more depth.

The truth. Long ago the chieftain Hallar Ash-Crown swore to guard the valley of Brannoch from a famine-winter, then fled with the clan's stores. His people buried him in a barrow with his hounds and cursed him to keep his vow in death. Now the barrow's braziers have lit themselves, smoke rolls down into the valley at night, and the cattle are found burned in their fields.

p.b: Brannoch is a dozen longhouses on a frozen river. The elder, Wenna Tull, meets you at the gate with soot on her hands. "Three nights now the hounds have come down from the barrow," she says. "They burn what they touch. Tomorrow it will be our homes."

text.p: The inciting vow (dangerous): I will end the burning that comes from the Cinder Barrow. Each character makes Swear an Iron Vow (+heart; +1 if they share a bond with Brannoch).

What the villagers know (Gather Information, +wits): the barrow is half a day north, past the split rock; its old name was the Hall of Hallar; "the chieftain broke his vow, and the dead do not forgive". Wenna offers a bond to whoever returns: Forge a Bond with Brannoch afterwards.

A troublesome journey (Undertake a Journey, then Reach Your Destination). At each waypoint, ask the oracle or use these: the split rock, scorched black on one side; a burned-out shieling where a Swarm of Crows feeds; prints in the snow that steam.
On a miss on the journey: a Cinder Hound hunts the party in the dusk (a fight: Enter the Fray).
Discover a Site: The Cinder Barrow, a haunted barrow (theme Haunted, domain Barrow; use the GM's Delve Sites tool), dangerous.

The map shows the barrow: the entry passage (bones, a fallen stone), the hall of four pillars with two braziers that never go out, the north and south tombs (Hallar's oath-sworn: two Barrow Dead rise if their coffins are opened), the burning hall (the altar where the oath-stone lies, four braziers), a collapsed tunnel to the east with a black pool, and a hidden vault behind a secret door south of the altar (the clan's stores, rotted to dust, and Hallar's oath-ring).
Use Delve the Depths to cross each area; its features and dangers come from the theme and domain.
When the party reaches the burning hall, Hallar, the Ash-Crowned Warden (formidable) rises from the altar's smoke with two Cinder Hounds.

He can be fought (End the Fight), or bargained with (Compel, +heart): he wants his vow kept at last. A character who swears to bring the clan's oath-ring back to Brannoch and lay it at the elders' hearth ends the curse when that vow is fulfilled. That is a new vow (formidable) and a story of its own.
Fulfill Your Vow when the burning ends. A strong hit: mark experience for a dangerous vow (2). Brannoch remembers.
